issues: What is the correct legal test for an internal flight alternative (IFA) finding by the Refugee Protection Division
Whether the RPD properly applied the two-pronged IFA test (no serious possibility of persecution in proposed area, and reasonableness of relocation in all circumstances)
What standard of review applies to the RPD's IFA determination on judicial review
Whether the RPD erred by failing to adequately assess the reasonableness prong of the IFA analysis given the claimant's personal circumstances
What evidentiary burden rests on the claimant to show the proposed IFA is unreasonable or unsafe
Whether the RPD's finding of a viable IFA is reasonable given a finding that the claimant's fear is otherwise genuine/credible
key_facts: Client fled persecution in her home country and made a refugee claim
The RPD found the client's fear of persecution to be genuine/credible
The RPD refused the claim solely on the basis that the client had a viable internal flight alternative (another city in the same country)
Client seeks judicial review of the RPD decision
causes_of_action: Application for judicial review of a Refugee Protection Division decision
search_terms: judicial review Refugee Protection Division decision
